name: Zramim
tagline: Studio-management platform with a self-service Hebrew phone line
oneLiner: A production, Hebrew-RTL management system for a swimming & water-aerobics studio: subscriptions, class scheduling, a reconciling financial ledger, and a full self-service IVR phone system (registration, card clearing, automated debt collection).
highlights: Atomic subscription registration in a single transactional Postgres function (subscription + N class bookings + ledger charge)
Customer-level financial ledger with automatic credit balances that eliminated a double-allocation bug
Two-model revenue accounting: cash ledger plus an accrual/deferred-revenue waterfall that reconciles to the bank

Full self-service IVR: caller-ID identification, status checks, phone registration + card payment, one-time class swaps (24h rule), unfreeze, waitlists, group codes, voicemail, and debt acknowledgement
Stateless IVR protocol given real back-navigation via a per-call navigation stack keyed by call-ID
Hebrew text-to-speech with nikud, including best-effort automatic vowelization validated so it can never corrupt names
Defense-in-depth authorization: identical role invariants enforced at both the app layer and via Row-Level Security
Adapter pattern for email, payments, and TTS so the app runs end-to-end before real integrations land
Hourly idempotent automation dispatcher driving debt alerts, renewal reminders, and scheduled reports
Timezone-correct scheduling pinned to Asia/Jerusalem (DST-aware) with no date library
features: Two-department separation (swimming / water-aerobics) with a unified customer list
Class-grid dashboard: enrolled / waiting / free seats in real time
Freeze / unfreeze subscriptions with 1-year balance expiry
Capacity control enforced by DB trigger, with manager override
Waitlists and future (pre-registration) groups with broadcast messaging
Debt tracking, collection-call logging, and automated escalation calls
Add-on product sales and expense tracking feeding an income report
Manager/secretary roles with financial data hidden from secretaries
Configurable email templates, report recipients, and automation schedules — all in-app
Hebrew calendar dates displayed alongside Gregorian
Health-declaration email flow with signed confirmation links
Manager-controllable phone menu: TTS, recordings, hours, and terms edited from settings
engineeringDecisions: Push atomicity into Postgres RPCs (registration, freeze/unfreeze, group change, reschedule)
Compute calendar occurrences in TypeScript, do the atomic write in SQL
Runtime-selected adapters with fail-safe defaults (noop email never falsely reports success)
Header-only shared secrets with constant-time comparison for machine endpoints
React cache() to memoize per-request auth loads; background work via Next after()
Hebrew-first error translation so raw server errors never leak to users
